For those of you dedicated to doing things the hard way here is the url you can manually copy and paste to donate, and I appreciate you very much 🦅 https://faxyourreps.com/donate
Hello. So I have made two websites. One of them you can send a postcard to your elected representatives or really anybody. Um, or you can FAX them cause some of them still have FAX numbers. So the coolest part of it is that it takes data from congress.gov and it helps you generate like a really good, um, succinct message that you send to your reps. Um, I made this for people like me who don't want to call anybody on the phone. You're mad at the government. Also, uh, have social anxiety and don't want to leave your house. Um, this is for you. Uh, this is the part where I tell you that it's not free to make. I would like to make it free for everybody, but donations really, really help and I could use them to keep making this thing better and keep it running. Maybe make everything free. That would be super awesome. Um, but on the facts website there's a quick little link. I don't have enough followers to do here, but um, it would be appreciated. Thank you.
